selection_rule: finite score AND exact-input nearest index preserved AND all OOD-passing query ranks <=50 AND full11 trustworthiness@10 >= measured baseline minus 1e-12; quality flags diagnostic only

hard_guard_spec.ood_fit_population: all reference rows only; input rows never used for fitting or calibration
hard_guard_spec.ood_distance: Euclidean after reference-only median imputation and StandardScaler
hard_guard_spec.trustworthiness_baseline_policy: Preserve the supplied saved baseline's full-feature reference trustworthiness; not a universal cutoff
hard_guard_spec.evaluation_order: trustworthiness and exact input always; remaining queries only if both pass

shortlist_audit.shortlist_rule: max archived score per distinct feature set among selection_valid=True rows

grid_design: Shared nonuniform discrete grid; retains all old values and adds local refinement points.
